messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] 03:07 UTC - GPU pool hotpath-us-west-2 exceeded capacity threshold (98% GPU util). Queue depth rising, first 429s observed. Paging on-call.
oncall-anna: acked. i'm looking. any customer impact yet?
maria.engineering: seeing increased 429s across multiple customers hitting models/redwood-opt-13b. queue length ~1200 requests, avg wait ~3.2s and tail >8s. autoscaler attempted scale but no new nodes came up (events show 'label mismatch').
sre-max: pulling logs now. autoscaler error: "no matching nodepool for tier=hotpath-v2" — looks like config drift after last infra rollout.
pm-jordan: customer-lina from Acme reported degraded latency and a spike in error rates on their dashboards. Lina, can you share any request patterns? @cust-eng-lina
cust-eng-lina: customers are sending steady LLM calls with occasional bursts (3-5s windows). they noticed first errors ~03:05 UTC. major workflows blocked for some users.
oncall-anna: initial mitigation: switching traffic to dedicated fallback pool (coldpath) would reduce errors but adds latency. we should try token-bucket relax first to reduce 429s and buy time for scale fix.
maria.engineering: agreed. token bucket policy for hotpath had refill=200 r/s and burst=400 configured during last rollout, but the routing policy expects per-model token units; looks like refill units are in 'tokens' not 'requests' -> miscalculation by 10x effective throttle.
sre-max: copying relevant config snippet:
```
route: hotpath-us-west-2
rate_limit:
  type: token_bucket
  token_unit: request
  refill_rate: 200   # currently interpreted as 200 tokens/sec
  burst: 400
  tiers: [gold, standard]
```

sre-max: but agent logs show token_unit was set to "model_unit" due to stale defaults, resulting in refill ~20 r/s effectively. that explains the saturation + 429s.
oncall-anna: ok, quick plan: 1) bump refill to 1000 requests/sec for hotpath as emergency; 2) temporarily move routing rule to allow fallback to warmpool; 3) fix autoscaler label mapping so we can actually scale. will execute 1 & 2 now.
maria.engineering: preparing patch for tokenbucket. command i'll run:
```
redwoodctl routes update hotpath-us-west-2 --rate.refill=1000 --rate.burst=1200
```
oncall-anna: running the patch now. will monitor 1 minute.
incident-bot: deploy-bot: Route update hotpath-us-west-2 started by maria.engineering.
maria.engineering: update applied. waiting for metrics. Prometheus panels: queue depth dropping from 1200 -> 300 over 30s. 429 rate decreasing.
sre-max: still no autoscaler nodes. there's a separate issue in autoscaler: nodepool selector uses label "pool-type: hot-v1" but the new pools are labeled "pool-type: hotpath-v2". will patch autoscaler to include both selectors.
maria.engineering: adding temporary label match to autoscaler yaml (one-line):
```
selector:
  matchExpressions:
    - {key: pool-type, operator: In, values: [hot-v1, hotpath-v2]}
```
sre-max: applied patch to autoscaler; triggering scale now.
incident-bot: autoscaler-controller: scale-up request accepted, provisioning 6 GPUs.
oncall-anna: good. monitor for node join and model warm-up. watch for longer-term tail latencies while KV cache warms.
pm-jordan: status for customer impact? any errors remaining for Acme?
cust-eng-lina: errors largely resolved for their main flows, a few residual spikes but within SLO now. they want ETA for full restoration.
oncall-anna: ETA for steady-state: node join + model load ~6-9 minutes. tokenbucket change should keep 429s low until then. I'll update customer.
maria.engineering: note for postmortem: root cause is twofold: 1) token_bucket unit mismatch (refill applied to wrong unit) created an overly restrictive effective rate; 2) autoscaler selector didn't match new pool labels after infra rollout, preventing scale-up. these interacted under burst traffic to cause queue growth and customer-visible 429s.
sre-max: mitigation summary:
- immediate: raised tokenbucket refill/burst for hotpath to 1000/1200
- short-term: patched autoscaler selector to include new labels
- fallback: enabled traffic spillover to warmpool for non-gold tiers
- monitoring: added alert for token_unit drift and autoscaler selector mismatch
pm-jordan: actions for follow-up and owners:
- maria.engineering: revert emergency tokenbucket only after postmortem and test suite + add unit-awareness validation (owner: maria)
- sre-max: reconcile autoscaler selectors across clusters and add e2e regression (owner: max)
- oncall-anna: notify customers + run RCA meeting (owner: anna)
- cust-eng-lina: coordinate customer comms and scheduled debrief with Acme (owner: lina)

oncall-anna: handing off to next on-call in 1 hour. if anything regresses, ping me and i'll re-awake.
incident-bot: pagerduty: Alert acknowledged by oncall-anna. Next on-call: oncall-boris.
pm-jordan: thanks all. i'll open a postmortem ticket and link configs + diffs. please attach any additional logs. good job on quick mitigation :thumbsup:
cust-eng-lina: passing to Acme support with status note. they'll want a timeline for permanent fix.
maria.engineering: adding a short test to CI to simulate token_unit mismatch and ensure rate limits behave as expected.
sre-max: will run a cluster-wide audit for label drift overnight and surface any other pools with mismatched selectors.
oncall-anna: closing handoff. final status: service degraded -> partial outage for ~12 minutes, then mitigated. follow-up RCA + prevention items assigned.
